title: ContentBlock
description: Task 004 foundation: single content unit. kind separates book content from explanation and enrichment. Narrative bodies are Markdown; verifiable structure is JSON. Every book block requires at least one traceable source; multiple sources are supported.

bodyMarkdown.description: Narrative body in Markdown for long explanatory text. Empty only for purely structural blocks.

sourceRefs.description: Traceable sources. Required (>=1) when kind=book. Multiple sources allowed; no single-source assumption.

coversElementIds.description: Coverage element ids this block actually treats. Back-reference proving treatment linkage; coverage blockIds must match.
